images.why: Caption confirms actual HHV-8 particles grown in cell culture, showing nucleocapsids, envelopes and tegument. Verified fallback only: grayscale, 700 × 324 px, requiring substantial cropping for 9:10. The source lists a 7.09 MB high-resolution download, but its direct URL could not be verified. No qualifying strong-colour alternative was verified.
